subject: Literature
title: American Transcendentalism
description: A short lesson to help you apply American Transcendentalism.

hook.text: In the 1830s, a group of New England thinkers declared that nature and intuition mattered more than tradition.

buildup.text: Ralph Waldo Emerson and Henry David Thoreau became the movement's leaders with essays on self-reliance.

discovery.text: Thoreau lived alone in the woods for two years and turned the experience into Walden, a literary landmark.

twist.text: Thoreau's civil disobedience essay later inspired Gandhi, Martin Luther King Jr., and protest movements globally.

climax.text: Transcendentalism gave American literature its own voice, independent of European literary traditions.

punchline.text: A cabin in the woods launched America's literary identity.

quiz.question: What did Thoreau's essay on civil disobedience inspire?
options: Gandhi, Martin Luther King Jr., and global protest movements
The founding of the United Nations
